settings.title: Izilungiselelo
auth.checkInbox: Hlola ibhokisi lakho le-imeyili ukuze uthole isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha iphasiwedi.
auth.copyLink: Kopisha isixhumanisi ukuze usivule kusiphequluli sakho
auth.landingLesson: Izifundo ezimfushane zokuthi imali isebenza kanjani lapha.
auth.errorCredentials: I-imeyili noma iphasiwedi ayilungile. Sicela uzame futhi.
auth.errorPasswordLen: Iphasiwedi kufanele ibe nezinhlamvu okungenani eziyi-8.
onboarding.writeOrSkip: Bhala lowo mgomo, noma weqe okwamanje.
onboarding.goalOtherHint: Bhala umgomo wakho: isib. ukongela imfundo yengane yami
goals.pickerBody: Sizobeka phambili izifundo ezihambisana nalokho ofuna ukukufeza.
auth.clickLink: Chofoza isixhumanisi kuleyo imeyili ukuze uvule i-akhawunti yakho. Hlola ifolda ye-spam uma ungayiboni.
auth.linkedinBody: Isiphequluli se-LinkedIn sivimba i-Google. Sebenzisa i-Apple, i-Facebook, i-imeyili, noma ukopishe isixhumanisi usivule ku-Chrome noma ku-Safari.
auth.landingTagline: Izifundo zemali ezibhalelwe iNingizimu Afrika. Iziliphu zomholo, ama-debit order, SARS, TFSAs.
auth.landingBudget: Faka isitatimende. Sisifunda kumemori futhi asiligcini ifayela.
auth.errorDisposable: Sicela ubhalise ngekheli le-imeyili langempela. Ama-imeyili esikhashana noma alahlwayo awavunyelwe.
onboarding.usernameBody: Kuyadingeka. Leli igama lakho elibonwa umphakathi: awukwazi ukuleqa.
onboarding.errMin: Igama lomsebenzisi kufanele libe nezinhlamvu okungenani ezi-3.
onboarding.errMax: Igama lomsebenzisi kufanele libe nezinhlamvu ezingama-20 noma ngaphansi.
onboarding.errChars: Sebenzisa izinhlamvu ezincane, izinombolo nama-underscore kuphela.
onboarding.goalBody: Akuphoqelekile. Khetha umgomo owodwa noma eminingi yemali, noma weqe ubeke lokhu kamuva kuthebhu yeMigomo.
settings.draftNotice: Ukuhumusha okwenziwe ngomshini kusalinde ukubuyekezwa abantu. Eminye imibhalo isesiNgisini.
